items.title: Walter "Furry" Lewis Interview, 1968-09-02
items.q: Do you know Sweet Williams? Sweet Williams? No. He was from New Orleans, but he moved to Chicago, and he said he was very impressed by a fishfire piano player who called himself Toots.

ctx.x: I have to walk, keep getting too sick. I never heard of him either.

He used to play only on the Black Keys. Who that? Boogers. Boogers? Yeah. And F-sharp. That's where this little Joe Hopkins played in F-sharp all the time. That's Sammy Hopkins' brother. Only on the Black Keys? Yeah. He's a nice, he's good on, he's a good piano player too. He sings with Joe Hopkins. But he's him. That's Sammy Hopkins' brother. I don't know. I think Sammy told me, yeah. Yeah, well he must have died lately, because the last time I saw Sammy on Canal Street, Sammy said he had an operation on his…
